items: the hand throws the stone upward, the stone rises slowly in slow motion and spins, the hand opens
the stone hangs in the sky slowly rotating, clouds drift below, then the stone starts falling down
the philosopher writes with the quill, his hand moving across the paper, then he slowly lifts his head and looks toward the window, candle flame flickers
the stone falls slowly past the window outside, candle flame flickers in the reflection
the giant king on the throne raises his arm and points down angrily, his beard and robe move in the wind, storm clouds swirl, lightning
slow camera pull back, the kneeling people slowly raise their heads to look at the ceiling, candles flicker
the glass prism slowly rotates on the desk, the beam of light sweeps across the papers
slow camera zoom out from the leaf, the leaf sways gently in the breeze, dew drops tremble
aerial camera glides forward over the forest toward the sea, waves roll in, mist moves
the wave rises and curls, the human figure inside the water walks forward and then dissolves back into the wave
the figure on the shore slowly raises his head to the stars, gentle waves wash the shore, stars twinkle
the peasant turns his face up to the rising sun and closes his eyes, wheat sways in the wind, windmill blades turn
rain pours across the fields, the figure walks away along the path, windmill turns, clouds race in time lapse
the brass gears turn steadily and the armillary sphere rotates, candle light glints on the metal
the sprout grows upward out of the rock crack and unfolds its first leaves, time lapse
the philosopher stands up from his chair, walks to the window and pushes it open, light floods over his face, he breathes in
people walk along the quay, a worker straightens up and strides forward, another man sits down tired on a barrel, boats bob on the water
the furious face slowly calms, breathing slows, the eyebrows relax, the jaw loosens, he lifts his head and his eyes soften
the iron chains loosen and slip off the wrists, the hands slowly open, light grows brighter
the seated philosopher slowly reaches his open hand into the beam of light, dust motes glow around his fingers, he smiles faintly
golden sunlight spreads slowly across the rooftops toward the sea, birds fly, ships sway
the open hand gently closes around the stone and then opens again, the fingers move slowly, warm light shifts
subtle portrait animation, the man in the painting blinks slowly and turns his eyes toward the viewer, very slight head movement
subtle animation of the old photograph, the man slowly turns his head slightly and his eyes move, very slight smile
